block.logos_dimension.journey_omikuji_bo: You already drew a fortune today
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.1: Dawn rose before you and is waiting at your door.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.2: What you seek is within reach. Remember to say thanks.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.3: Set out for far shores. New ground will repay each step.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.4: The furnace burns true. What you start now will come out well.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.5: Fair wind in your sails. Still, keep an eye out for rocks.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.6: A fox tail brushed your shoulder. Walk on, and do not look back.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.7: Speak the thing you have held back. An answer is ready for it.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.1: The clouds part after noon. No need to rush out the door.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.2: A fellow traveler is coming. Slow your pace a little.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.3: Your seed has taken root. Stop digging it up to check.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.4: A boat waits at the ferry. Better on time than early.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.5: One more careful pass, and the work will begin to shine.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.6: Far from home, ask the way. Someone will point you right.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.7: Past the halfway mark the view improves. Do not rest too long.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.1: The tea is warm enough. Leave the coals alone.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.2: No wind, no rain. A fine day to mend the fence.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.3: Pick up what you set aside. It still has some use in it.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.4: Little lost, enough gained. Let that be plenty.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.5: A neighbor's idle word may answer a small question.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.6: Eat while it is hot, walk without hurry, and all stays well.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.7: Settle your accounts by sundown and you will sleep sound.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.1: Mind your step, and that is one fall you will not take.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.2: Check your deep pockets. A forgotten coin may be hiding there.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.3: A swallow returns to the eaves. Small news, but glad news.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.4: Read the vial's label twice and spare yourself a fright.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.5: This morning's porridge tastes better. Do not gulp it.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.6: The wayside berries have ripened just in time.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.7: A small greeting buys you half a day of good cheer.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.1: The bud is still shut. It is waiting on an east wind.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.2: The tide is going out. When it turns, it turns for you.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.3: The wine is still in the cellar. Too soon to break the seal.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.4: The night road ends soon. The lamp is over the next hill.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.5: What slips away today will find you again further on.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.6: Your letter is on its way. It simply walks slowly.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.7: The fox has written down your name. Another day, then.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.1: Pick no quarrels today. Even a win would cost you.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.2: This slip weighs on the hand. Tie it up and go home light.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.3: Keep off night roads, and beware the too-sweet smile.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.4: A crack runs through your flask. Find it before it finds you.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.5: Loose talk brings trouble. Tie this up and walk home quiet.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.6: Leave the ill omen here. The fox will watch it for you.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.7: The bridge planks are rotten. The long way still gets you home.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.1: Black clouds overhead. Stop everything, and tie this slip first.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.2: Your lamp runs low. Turn back now, while the way is still clear.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.3: The shadow at your door is not your own. Bar it before dark.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.4: Do not carry this down the hill. Leave it on the rack and walk free.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.5: All you lean on will give way today. Only caution holds.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.6: Snow has shut the pass. Sit out the day; there is still tomorrow.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.7: Ill luck knows your face. Tie this up, and take another road.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.0: Buyers wait at your door before the goods are out.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.1: A far-sailing ship returns with its holds full.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.2: Copper knocks first; the gold crown follows.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.4: Name your price; leave room for those who return.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.5: What you stored turns to gold in one morning.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.6: The fox checked your abacus; every bead runs true.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.7: Wealth comes in like a tide; mind your banks.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.0: A small purse, walked slowly, still arrives.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.1: Keep asking; a fair price waits at the last stall.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.2: Each coin in the box rings a small, good note.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.3: A buyer wavers; pour them one more cup of tea.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.4: A letter from afar may carry modest custom.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.5: Little gained, save a customer worth keeping.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.6: Keep the scales level, and trade keeps steady.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.7: Old wares, made fresh, can still fetch a koban.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.0: Cheap goods are cheap for a reason.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.1: Read the partner's contract once more.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.2: Mend the hole in your purse before you walk on.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.3: The market lies in fog. Wait until it lifts.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.4: Coin lent out may be slow to find its way home.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.5: Grasp at a penny and lose the sale.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.6: Ships run late; goods may land out of season.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.7: Behind that smile, an abacus is clicking.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.0: Gold falls like leaves when the autumn wind blows.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.1: The rats in your store grow fat. Count it all now.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.2: Thieves line this road. Keep your gold from sight.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.3: Rich promises are bait upon a hook.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.4: Dreams of alchemic gold wake to cold ash.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.5: Sign today, and you will rue it for many a day.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.6: The loss is sure. Let some go to save the rest.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.7: Your capital thins. Shut shop; the tide may turn.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.0: The tide is rising. Your boat need only cast off.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.1: A fox tail brushes the scale; it tips your way.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.2: The tavern talk holds true. Keep it to yourself.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.3: Bare boughs are budding. The keen cut one early.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.4: The ink is still wet, and luck is on the page.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.5: Fine horse, open road. Keep hold of the reins.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.6: Coin rings sweet. Take it, and know when to stop.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.7: The geese keep faith. Good word is on its way.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.0: A crack in the cloud, enough to read the sky.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.1: Cross by small steps; each stone will hold.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.2: The rumor rings true. Ask one more to be sure.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.3: Kind fortune waits at the exchange. Go early.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.4: The wind warms; swallows under the eaves know.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.5: Ripe fruit will fall. Wait beneath the bough.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.6: Bear the quiet a while, and an echo will come.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.7: Those with tidy ledgers find small gains.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.0: Fog on the ford. Board no boat blind.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.1: Gossip clings like down and is slow to shake off.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.2: The hare you chase runs for the thorns.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.3: The door all crowd toward is the narrowest.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.4: The scale sits a little off. Look twice.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.5: The notice reads calm. Mind what lies behind it.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.6: A draft in the purse. Tie it tight first.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.7: No lantern on the night road. Best head home.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.0: Ants in the dike. Leave before the water rises.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.1: Sweet talk fills the lane, every word a hook.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.2: High towers, hard winds. Climb now and regret it.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.3: Gold in a mirror shatters at the touch.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.4: Thin ice. Do not covet the lights across.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.5: Ink spills over all. Only idle hands stay clean.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.6: The ledgers are shut. Ask no prices today.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.7: A flood comes. Drop the load; fish another day.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.0: One arrow at dawn scatters many. Chase none.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.1: Fair wind, true string; every way lies open.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.2: Where the spear points, gates swing wide.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.3: Foxfire leads; night battles are clear as day.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.4: Victory runs like a tide. Stop at its crest.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.5: A strong foe before you: your name awaits.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.6: Gain one step early; the rest come at ease.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.7: The sword hums in its case. Draw, without pride.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.0: Hold steady; the gap will show itself.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.1: Guard first; the counter will come to hand.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.2: Slightly off, the arrow still finds its mark.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.3: Old wounds have closed. Keep that old rematch.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.4: Go with company; someone will catch your fall.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.5: Small wins gather. No need for one great blow.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.6: Whet the blade tonight; tomorrow it bites.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.7: Many foes, one loose will. Strike their leader.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.0: Your straps work loose. Tie them once more.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.1: Nothing is settled yet; stake nothing on it.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.2: A moment's daring, a long look back.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.3: The ground favors them. Step back and look.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.4: The edge has turned. Trust not its old bite.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.5: Your rival hides their skill. Doubt that stumble.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.6: Mist on the road; it may be hiding blades.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.7: They goad you with words. Do not answer.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.0: The blade breaks on the road. Turn home at once.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.1: Black clouds loom. Who retreats stays whole.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.2: One urge to win, and the whole board is lost.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.3: The fox covers its eyes. Do not fight today.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.4: An abyss ahead, the road behind. Turn and live.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.5: String snapped, arrow fallen; they will laugh.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.6: Not a foe for today. Save your life for later.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.7: To yield is no shame. To die for pride is folly.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.0: One lamplit thought unties every old knot.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.1: The rune flows from your pen. Do not boast of it.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.2: The page that long resisted opens tonight.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.3: The wand obeys like your own arm.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.4: No teacher beside you, yet the way is in hand.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.5: The fox turns the page for you. Read on.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.6: Your chant begins, and the very walls answer.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.7: Insight wells like a spring. Drink, do not drown.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.0: Patient ink finds the door, little by little.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.1: Even a torn page has something to teach.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.2: Small workings first; greater ones will follow.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.3: Ask the novice too. Answers hide in odd places.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.4: Check it once more; the flaw will show itself.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.5: Read a little late; morning brings understanding.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.6: A faint glow at the wand's tip. Follow it.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.7: Your old notes hold a new answer.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.0: One stray stroke can ruin a page. Take care.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.1: A restless mind cannot enter a book. Sit first.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.2: Half-understood is the most dangerous kind.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.3: The words slip mid-chant. Go over them again.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.4: Better one page digested than ten swallowed.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.5: The wand sits heavy. Do not force it.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.6: Copied workings seldom serve the copyist.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.7: Tired eyes read poorly. Better to rest early.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.0: You know every word, and no sentence makes sense.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.1: Spells turn on their makers. Try nothing new.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.2: Each correction breeds two. Put down the pen.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.3: The chant will not come. Do not strain for it.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.4: What feels like insight is a wrong turn.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.5: Ink on the scroll. Recopy it; all is not lost.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.6: The book has closed itself. Ask nothing today.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.7: The tunnel ends here. Turn back and ask for help.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.0: One seed sown, a thousand come home.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.1: Gold rolls the rows; scent outruns the sickle.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.2: Rain knows its hour. Just get the seed in.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.3: Vines hang heavy with jewels; bring more baskets.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.4: Where the fox has trod, no weed takes root.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.5: Full barns are foretold. Keep back the seed.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.6: The earth runs strong; even dead wood buds.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.7: Reap briskly; even bounty fears the night rain.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.0: Even rows, strong shoots. The hoe is repaid.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.1: Spirit shoots are waking; tend them gently.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.2: A little to spare; share a measure next door.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.3: Dew on the leaf favors the early riser.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.4: The berries redden. A few days' patience yet.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.5: Turn the old rows; the soil will answer.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.6: No great year, but the table will be full.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.7: Sparrows come and go, taking but a few grains.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.0: Better a day of sky-watching than an early sowing.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.1: Thin soil. Feed the ground before asking of it.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.2: Pests hide under the leaf. Turn it and look.

line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.greet: …Yes. What would you have me do?
What is it? Go on, I'm listening.
Coming, coming — what is it this time?
Here to talk again? …I suppose I don't mind.
There you are. …You did well today.
Hehe, I knew you would come find me.
You're covered in wounds… Stay put for a bit, okay?
Just so you know — I'm a little hungry.
Still up this late? …Fine, I'll keep you company.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.katas: Isn't the katashiro right there on you? …Honestly, keep it safe.
I need a sheet of paper to fold one. Bring me paper and I'll make you another.
…There. It has your name on it, so don't lose it this time.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.food_: Sweet berries, and woodland blueberries! Sweet and a little sour — my favourite.
Don't bring me rotten flesh or poisonous potatoes… I'm not some wild fox.
…Now that you mention it, I am a little hungry.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.past_: My name is Shiraume. Someone gave it to me long ago… they said I looked like white plum blossoms in early spring.
Other things… I can't quite remember yet. When I do, I'll tell you.
It was cold inside the Sessho-seki, and so quiet. At first I counted the days… then I lost count.
Sometimes I heard foxes walking by outside. I called to them. No one could hear.
I remember now. There was a small Inari shrine at the foot of a mountain, with a white plum tree behind it.
Every year when it bloomed, the villagers came to pray and brought me fried tofu. …Those were good days.
Foxfire is meant to be pale blue. Mine is pink… probably because I lit my first one under the plum blossoms.
The other foxes laughed, back then — said it looked like petals, not fire. Hmph. Let them try laughing now.
A fox's power rests on people's faith. As long as someone remembers us, we stay strong.
So… as long as you remember me, I won't grow weak. That matters a great deal, you know.
The day my ninth tail grew, every fox on the mountain came. I was so happy I never slept that night.
…Are you counting how old I am? Don't you dare!
It was snowing hard that day. I drew my blade… why, I still can't remember.
I only remember the foxfire on the blade turning the snow pink. And someone was crying.
Later a monk named Gennō came. One blow of his staff, and the Sessho-seki broke into many pieces.
The pieces flew to every corner of the sea of clouds. That's why I'm in pieces now.
Have you heard of Lady Sumihomi? Long ago, she was the one who held back the corruption.
The foxes say she didn't drive people away — she chose to learn to live alongside them. Back then, I didn't understand.
…I remember all of it now. The good and the bad.
I did terrible things once. And still you found me, piece by piece…
So this time, it's my turn to watch over you. Please keep taking care of me.
…What came after, I can't remember yet.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.tails: My power is sealed in Sessho-seki scattered across the White Sakura Sea of Clouds. Defeat the remnant in one and you will bring back a blank katashiro.
Stamp a seal on me with a blank katashiro… and one of my tails will light up.
Each piece of power you bring back lights a tail tip, and I remember a little more of the past.
All nine tails are lit. …Thank you for finding me, piece by piece.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.us_st: …You are my master. I will make amends, properly.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.us_fa: Y-you're all right, I guess. At least… I don't hate you.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.us_cl: Travelling with you beats sitting in a stone. …That wasn't a compliment.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.us_tr: …I trust you. So don't you leave me behind, got it?
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.outfi: Back to the miko robes. They are easier on the road.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.rest: Then I'll rest in the katashiro for a while. …Call me if you need me.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.follo: All right, I'm right behind you.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.stay: Then I'll wait here. …Don't keep me waiting long.
line.logos_dimension.shiraume.talk.pvp_o: ...Raise my blade against people too? Fine. Whoever strikes you, or whoever you strike, I won't let go.
Mm. People are yours to deal with, then. I'll only handle the rest.
...Though this land forbids people fighting each other, so I can't either.

Then I'll keep my distance and use foxfire.
Up close? Ryuka could use the exercise.
…No fighting? Fine, I'll stay behind you. I'll still stop arrows for you.

Heals %s health to whoever is worst off nearby: you, your pets and familiars, other companions, forest elves, or herself. Other wounded allies within %s blocks of them get half. Once every %s s.
Wounded allies within %s blocks of her heal every %s s for %s health. She does not need to stop and cast.
As soon as you start fighting she puts a handful of life force into your hand: each of your blows adds %s life damage for %s s. Cooldown %s s.
Whoever is nearly down and still being hunted gets a %s-point shield first. Cooldown %s s.
She kneels and presses the ground; thorns grow in a ring around a strong enemy and stay for ten seconds. Each touch deals %s life damage and pulls toward the middle. Cooldown %s s.

She never falls: when she can take no more, a lotus grows up around her and sinks back into the bagged world tree, where she rests. You can call her again after %s minutes.

Her arrows, heals, shields and thorns all scale with her own spell power (now ×%s): her own, plus your bond, plus what she inherits from you (your spell power and life spell power). It changes with your attributes and her leaf seals.

talk.logos_dimension.elf_princess.memory: The Year the Leaves Turned Black
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.stay: Okay, I'll wait right here... d-don't forget to come back for me.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.refuse: This one... I'm sorry, I can't eat it...
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.full: I-I'm full already... any more and my dress won't fit.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.stuck: Ugh, I'm stuck... I'll go back into the tree. Call me out again, okay?
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.hungry: Um... I think my tummy just rumbled... did you hear that?
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.seal: The little tree in the bag... grew another leaf. Thank you, I'll try even harder!
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.remake: Hup... done! A handful of soil, a little sapling, and your name on the tag. Keep it safe this time.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.chance: Even if the chance is one in ten thousand...! Please, hold on a little longer!
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.bless: Give me your hand... here's a little of the forest's strength!
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.thorns: Thorns, please help me - hold it down!
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.late_s: ...Huh? Waah! W-when did that get here?!
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.b: Okay, I'll go look at the flowers for a bit.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.r: Then I'll rest in the tree for a while... call me when you need me.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.g: You're hurt! Hold still, let me see...
Ah, um... could we eat something first? Just a little...
The forest sings at night. Listen - oh, you can't hear it?
H-hello! What is it? I-I'll listen carefully!
Hm? Me? ...Oh, you do mean me.
Thanks for today too. Want to talk?
I was counting clouds... oh, what did you want to say?
There you are! I was just wanting to talk to you.
With you beside me I'm not scared of anything... probably.
Go on, go on, I'm listening.
...I was wondering where I'd be now if I'd never met you.
Hm? I just... wanted to look at you a little longer.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.f: Honey! And glow berries, and apples... sweet things are the best.
Meat... we elves don't eat much of it. Not that we can't, I just keep picturing them running through the woods.
Speaking of which... I'm a little hungry right now...
Can't you hear it? The forest is crying. When the wind goes through the leaves, it isn't rustling. It's crying.
It is the corruption. It crawls up from below and wraps the roots, and the trees fall silent one by one.
...So I want to try. Even if the chance is one in ten thousand.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.m: Purifying the Heart of Corruption... it isn't really my job. The elders say it's for the wardens.
But I'm a princess. A princess is... the one who stands in front when everyone is scared.
That's what I think, anyway. So even if someone says no, I'm going. ...Is that selfish?
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.p: The rest... I'll tell you when the little tree in the bag grows another leaf.
I grew up under the World Tree. As a child I thought it was the whole world. Later I learned the world is even bigger.
Still, it's my favourite place. The leaf shadows on your face feel warm.
I have an aunt. She is amazing. She can sing songs that make flowers open, and whistle bird calls on a single leaf.
The first thing she taught me: there are no bad children in the forest, only lost ones.
I made my first bow myself. The string snapped on the first pull, and the arrow spun three times and landed at my own feet.
Auntie laughed for ages... then lent me her bow. I was too happy to sleep that night.
The forest never lies. A sick tree is sick, dirty water is dirty. It never pretends it's fine.
Sometimes I wish I could be like the forest, and not pretend I'm fine.
I got lost once as a child. I chased a glowing butterfly, and when I looked up, every tree around me was a stranger.
The World Tree's roots led me home. Ever since, I've felt it watching over me.
There is a lotus pond under the World Tree. The lotuses open by day and close at night, as if they were sleeping.
When I'm very tired, the World Tree wraps me up like a lotus. So I never fall. I just... go back and sleep.
When the corruption first appeared, nobody took it seriously. Just a few blackened leaves, a few birds that never came back.
By the time everyone noticed... Auntie was already gone.
Life force can purify corruption. But sometimes what gets purified vanishes along with it.
So I've practised for a long time, trying to take only the corruption and leave the rest. ...I haven't quite got it yet.
The elders say the chance of purifying the Heart of Corruption is maybe one in ten thousand.
I thought about it, and one in ten thousand isn't zero.
The truth is, I've always been scared. Scared the forest will never sing again, scared I'll never find Auntie, scared I'm too clumsy to do anything right.
But since I've been with you... I'm not so scared anymore.
Thank you. Really. ...Ah, was that too serious? Hehe.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.l: The little tree in the bag? It's a sprig of the World Tree. When I'm tired I go back inside it to sleep.
If you ever find another bagged world tree, would you show it to me? The little tree might grow a new leaf.
The little tree grew another leaf! Each one helps me remember more, and do more.
It has %s now. %s more and it's full.
All nine leaves are here... look, it's blooming. I'm so glad I came this far with you.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.u: You're... a good person, right? Mm, I think so.
You walk so fast... but I can keep up!
I'm happy when I'm with you. I can even forget about the corruption for a while.
I can trust you with my back. ...Ah, that sounds funny coming from an archer.
You are the most important person to me. The forest is my witness.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.f: Mm! I'll follow you. I won't get lost... I think.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.s: Okay, I'll wait here. ...Come back, okay?
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.p: W-we're fighting people...? If they're picking on you, I'll help.
Mm, no fighting people. It's best when everyone is safe.
...But this land doesn't seem to allow people to hurt each other. So I won't.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.t: Leave it to me! Shoot when they're far, hop back and shoot when they're close!
Then I'll shoot from further back. Don't run too far ahead.
C-closer? Then I'll draw sideways and hit a whole bunch at once!
No fighting...? Then I'll hide behind you. I'll still heal you if you get hurt!
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.b: Isn't it right there in your bag? Hehe, you can be scatterbrained too.
To make another... could you find me a sapling? Any kind of tree is fine.
Here. Keep it safe this time, don't lose it again.
line.logos_dimension.elf_princess.talk.p: Everything's still there, right? I carried it very carefully.

talk.logos_dimension.kohaku.name: Kohaku
talk.logos_dimension.kohaku.epithet: The Lazy Genius of the Greenhouse
What do you like to eat?
Tell me about the Starbloom City
What do you think of me?
talk.logos_dimension.kohaku.skill.one_dr: A drop of amber arcane flicks from the staff tip, fast and true, piercing one. Damage %s, cooldown %s s. Why write two pages when one will do?
talk.logos_dimension.kohaku.skill.ward.d: When a fight starts she wraps herself in a shield: %s times her max health (%s now). It costs %s%% of her max mana and reforms %s s after it breaks. When her mana runs low, this is all she cares about.
She holds %s, which stores up to %s mana. %s What it stores goes first, cast at once; only then does she channel from herself.

talk.logos_dimension.kohaku.memory.0.tit: On Being Taken for a Lost Child
talk.logos_dimension.kohaku.memory.8.tit: When I Could Not Work It Out
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.full: Full. Any more and I'll get sleepy. ...I'm sleepy anyway.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.stuck: Stuck... I'll rest in the sovereign. Call me again.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.remake: Replacements cost extra. ...Here, don't lose it.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.bye: Mm. I'll lie down here a while.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.rest: Mm, I'll go nap. Take out the sovereign when you miss me.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.greet_h: ...You've done it to yourself again. Come here, hold still.
Mm... Hungry. Anything in the pouch? If not, go get something.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.greet_n: It's night. The plaza lights should be on by now... No, I didn't say I wanted to go.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.greet_s: Hm? Say it if it's something. Otherwise I'm lying down.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.greet_f: Mm... You're here. Sit. The ground's fine.
Go on, I'm listening. ...Eyes closed still counts.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.greet_c: Here to talk again. ...You're quite punctual.
Mm. You look less silly than usual today.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.greet_t: I was just thinking of you, and here you are. ...Coincidence.
Come here. You can lean on my tail. Just for a bit.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.greet_b: ...As long as you're here. Talk about anything you like.
Long day again. I've been keeping track for you.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.us_stra: My employer. The one who pays. ...That will do for now.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.us_fami: Mm... Not bad. Anyone who lets me lie down isn't bad.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.us_clos: A little more interesting than I expected. Your spells are still a mess.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.us_trus: You're one of mine. Anyone who touches you learns what a transmutation circle is.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.us_bond: ...Don't make me say it. You know.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.food_1: Cooked salmon, cooked cod, and cake. The fish should be crisp on the outside.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.food_2: Rotten flesh, spider eyes, pufferfish, no thanks. Beetroot soup... the colour is frightening.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.food_hu: Speaking of which, I'm rather hungry right now.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.alchemy: Alchemy is just letting things become what they wanted to be all along.
The professors write half a book going round in circles, when one drop does the middle step. ...I just find them long-winded.
Spells are the same. You write ten lines, I cut them to three and it works better. Want to try?
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.lazy_1: Not lazy. Efficient. If I can work it out lying down, why stand?
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.lazy_2: ...And when it's time to act, I'm not slow at all. You've seen it.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.city_1: The Starbloom City, the brightest town in the Hexenwald. At night the whole plaza glows.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.city_2: Behind the academy there's a row of wooden greenhouses, warm even in winter. I've slept through a lot of afternoons there.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.city_3: ...I'll take you some day. Just don't get lost. I'm not searching the whole city for you.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.money_1: Money doesn't matter. But only money buys absolute freedom: sleep when you like, leave when you like.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.money_2: So you hired me, and I follow you freely. Fair, isn't it?
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.enforce: The academy's enforcers? Mm... They take the long way round when they see me.
I didn't do anything wrong. They picked on a junior of mine once, so I adjusted their circles a little. ...They spent the night on a roof.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.coin_ha: It's on you. ...Don't look at me, I didn't go through your things.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.coin_ne: Replacements cost extra. Bring me a cat sovereign and I'll press you another.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.coin_gi: Keep it safe. Lose it again and the price goes up.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.seals_n: Bring me a blank Paw-Print Sovereign. I'll bite it, and if it's real gold, I'll press it.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.seals_1: Mm, the paw prints on the back. The more there are, the more I remember.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.seals_f: ...All nine. You really want to keep me, huh.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.stay: I'll wait here. ...Don't take too long, I'll fall asleep.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.pvp_on: Players too? ...Fine. Whoever raises a hand to you, I raise one to them.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.pvp_off: Mm, no more players. Less work.
...Though it seems that isn't allowed here. Then I won't.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.tactic_: Use my judgement? Fine. I'll pick the least effort.
From far away? Just how I like it.
Stand closer... What a bother. I'm a mage, you know.
Stay out of it? Sure, I'll watch from behind you. ...Anything that comes close still gets hissed at.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.pouch_b: Pouch is packed. If that staff is from you, I'll use it well.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_mo: ...The rest can wait for your next Paw Seal.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_0_: Back at the academy, I was sunning myself on the greenhouse lawn once, and a kind first-year crouched down to ask if I had lost my parents.
Before I could explain, that old professor with the white beard came trotting over, all smiles, to ask me about a catalysis formula.
Oh, the look on that first-year's face, frozen on the spot. It still makes me laugh.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_1_: I have a key of my own to the academy's wooden greenhouses. I changed the lock, and now it only opens for my paw.
...The professors know. Nobody says anything. I did save last year's whole crop of starlight moss on my own.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_2_: At night the plaza lamps light one by one, all shimmer and colour, and hardly anyone is out. That is when I like to wander.
Strolling about alone was fine. No one following, so no one complaining I walk slowly.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_3_: Honestly, when I took your job, all I thought was that money means freedom.
...Then it turned out that following you around is a little freer than staying in the greenhouse. Don't get smug.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_4_: I've peeked at a few of your spells. A mess. There's a part that can never run.
Still... the idea is interesting. I changed one word for you. You didn't notice, did you?
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_5_: I used to stew for one. Now there is always a little extra in the pot.
...You'll eat the extra anyway. Don't thank me.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_6_: For years I napped in the greenhouse. Alone, in the sun, very quiet.
Now I doze beside you and sleep deeper, it seems. ...Only because you're so noisy it wears me out.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_7_: The academy wrote, asking if I'd come back. The enforcer's handwriting was shaking. Afraid I'd come after them again, I suppose.
I wrote back two words: busy now. ...Running around after you counts as busy.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_8_: That time you fell, every formula went out of my head at once.
Thinking back, it was the first time I did not want the least-effort answer.
...So don't do that to me again. It's exhausting.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.past_9_: I used to think only money could buy absolute freedom.
Now... I still think so. Only, I want to spend that freedom staying by your side.
...You are not allowed to write that down anywhere.

line.logos_dimension.kohaku.give_food: ...Eat. If you go hungry I'll only have to look after you. What a bother.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.fetch: ...Look, this one's the most interesting. For you.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.critiqu: There's no page in your hand. ...Shall I critique your hand instead?
It's blank. You want my opinion on the paper? ...The paper's fine.
...This one doesn't even compile. Find the wrong line yourself.
This paper can't hold it; it'll fall apart the moment you cast. Better paper, or fewer lines.
Far too hungry for mana. You couldn't cast it once on your own.
You didn't inject enough mana for it. It'll run dry halfway. Give :mana a little more.
There's a part that can never run: the condition is fixed. Cut it, or use one that actually changes.
You inject far more mana than it uses. Most of it goes nowhere. Be thrifty, with mana and money both.
Recursion... Every layer pays for its mana again. You're sure you want it like this?
...Not bad. It reaches, and it hurts. Nothing to pick at.
...Not bad. Nothing to pick at. Don't get smug.
line.logos_dimension.kohaku.talk.allowan: Pocket money? ...Mm, I'll take it. Don't expect a thank-you.
A whole sovereign? Too much. ...Nineteen shillings back. I only want one.
I've already had today's. Greedy employers aren't popular.
...You don't have a single cat coin on you. Pocket money needs money first.

line.logos_dimension.kohaku.morning_gift: ...Morning. This is for you. I just happened to have it.
